question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is **"definetly"**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given options, the incorrectly spelled word is **'definetly.'**
 
• The correct spelling of the word is **'definitely.'**
 
• **Definitely:** without any doubt.
 
 
• **Example:** *He **definitely** said he would be here.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• ​__Let's look at the usage and meaning of the other options.

 
 

 **Words**
 **Meaning**
 **Example**
 
 

 **Characteristic** 
 a typical or noticeable quality of someone or something.
 Unfortunately, a big nose is a family **characteristic.**
 
 

 **Appearance**
 to be present for a short time.
 I didn't really want to go to the party, but I thought I would better put in an **appearance.**
 
 

 **Controversy**
 a lot of disagreement or argument about something.
 The police had caused heated **controversy** ever since it was introduced.
